name: Brag
summary: British 3-card ancestor of poker where players ante, receive three cards and vie with bets and bluffs for the pot.
rules_text: Each player antes. Dealer deals three cards face down to each player from a 52-card deck. There is one betting round, starting left of dealer. On a turn you may fold or place a bet. If there is a prior bet, you must contribute at least that amount extra to stay in; past contributions are ignored for sizing unlike poker. Betting continues clockwise until only two players remain. When two remain, either may double the previous bet to see the opponent, forcing a showdown. Best 3-card hand wins entire pot; if tied the seer loses. Ranking: prial (three of a kind) high (usually 3-3-3 top), then straight flush (run on the bounce, A-2-3 top), run (straight), flush, pair, high card. A run beats a flush.
rating_reason: Bluffing vying game, poker ancestor, hidden hands and betting.
